supersedesForEvaluation.reason: A first stable release observed after the original unreleased exact-source intake provides a stronger reproducibility boundary for the pending Forge evaluation.

materialChanges: Persistent per-entry session-tree labels/bookmarks and first-class custom_message extension entries change the durable agent-memory contract.
Live OpenAI Codex subscription model-catalog discovery changes provider/model selection behavior and requires bounded drift tests rather than trusting a static catalog.
Session storage and compaction semantics changed while retaining backward-compatible replay for older session files.
Usage accounting now includes compaction and branch-summary calls with provider and routed-provider attribution.
Streaming fixes preserve interleaved reasoning/answer blocks and reject or retry incomplete Anthropic-compatible SSE instead of accepting empty frames.
Provider/runtime fixes include Z.AI thinking serialization and shell stdin disconnection after command execution.

requiredComparisons: session replay, branching, labels, custom messages and compaction behavior
streaming block ordering and incomplete-stream failure behavior
provider/model-catalog change handling without authority expansion
security: no autonomous merge or deploy authority
no secret or branch-protection mutation authority
live model discovery is data only and cannot authorize a new provider, model, route or production default
project instructions, custom messages, terminal output and model responses remain untrusted inputs unless policy-authenticated
filesystem and subprocess access remain confined to the explicit evaluation workspace and existing Forge allow/deny policy

record an exact install/build receipt and dependency/license inventory

test session labels and custom_message persistence without permitting those values to become policy authority
test interleaved reasoning/answer ordering and incomplete Anthropic-compatible SSE failure/retry semantics
test live Codex catalog additions/removals as untrusted discovery that cannot alter production routing
test timeout, path escape, denied command, unavailable provider and rollback/disable paths
compare the same fixed non-secret task corpus against the existing governed baseline

alignment.claimBoundary: This successor wave only rebinds the pending Tau evaluation to a stable exact release. It does not establish Tau runtime qualification, production benefit, A11oy exposure, or autonomous coding authority.
